title: skill_budget_fence.mjs — blocking byte-budget + provenance fence, baseline re-seed, chain registration
action: Create scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs owning the budget machinery end-to-end (per D6): (1) reads scripts/skill-body-budget.json; any skills/*/SKILL.md whose byte size (fs.statSync .size, same as wc -c) exceeds its recorded budget => process exit 1 with message naming skill, size, budget, delta ('pay for new text by removing text'); a skill directory with SKILL.md but no baseline entry => exit 1; missing baseline file => exit 1, never silent. (2) --update-baseline moves HERE from skill_lint.mjs: seeds new entries at current size, lowers after a trim, refuses to raise. The ONE-TIME drift re-seed in THIS cell is a direct edit of skill-body-budget.json (the file is in this cell's files list) to exact current sizes — NOT via --update-baseline, which refuses raises (validation D1): bee-hive 29808->30078, bee-swarming 24178->24676, bee-validating 17484->18273, bee-compounding 13842->14079; all other entries confirmed equal to current size or re-seeded likewise. (3) Provenance grep per D8: applies ONLY to skills listed in the baseline JSON's top-level "migrated": [] array (seeded EMPTY in this cell; each migration commit appends its skill) — body lines matching tunable pattern /\((D\d|AO\d|decision [0-9a-f]|hardening-\d|plan \d)/ => exit 1 for listed skills. NOT inferred from budget size (validation D2: bee-context-locking is 6454B yet unmigrated with 11 pattern matches — a budget<=8192 inference would red the chain immediately). (4) Exception rule per D1: a baseline entry > 8192 requires a sibling notes.<skill> justification string in the JSON ('pending migration' for grandfathers) else exit 1 — seed notes for every skill currently > 8192. (5) --selftest proves the fence BITES on temp-dir fixtures (okf fence precedent): over-budget body fails; provenance citation in a skill LISTED in migrated fails; unlisted skill with citations passes; grandfathered skill with note passes. (6) Register in scripts/run_verify.mjs beside the okf fences as the pair ['scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs','--selftest'] + ['scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs']. (7) Trim scripts/skill_lint.mjs: remove its body-budget check and --update-baseline (fence owns both; leave a one-line pointer comment), keep anchor-integrity + ordered-list checks advisory exit-0 (2026-07-27 lint law, narrowed only for the fence's checks per D6 supersession).

truths: node scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs exits 1 when any body exceeds its recorded budget, when a skill lacks an entry, when the baseline file is missing, or when a >8192 budget has no notes justification; exits 0 on the current re-seeded repo.
node scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs --selftest exercises the bite fixtures and exits 0 only when every fixture bites as specified.
skill-body-budget.json re-seeded to exact current byte sizes, carries migrated: [] and notes.<skill> = 'pending migration' for every skill > 8192.
Provenance grep fires only for skills in the migrated array; bee-context-locking (unlisted, 11 matches) stays green.
run_verify.mjs runs the selftest+bare pair; skill_lint.mjs no longer carries a budget check or --update-baseline and still exits 0 always.
prohibitions: Do NOT block anchor-integrity or ordered-list checks — they stay advisory in skill_lint.mjs.
Do NOT measure rendered artifacts — source bytes of skills/*/SKILL.md only (D3).
Do NOT add a frontmatter budget mechanism (superseded by D6).
Do NOT infer migrated status from budget size (validation D2).
Do NOT edit any skills/*/SKILL.md body in this cell.
